status: AUTHORIZED C4 DREGON alternating conditional MAP training manifest — round 4 DREGON-focused refinement
notes: Per-rig C4 fit manifest for scripts/stochastic_fit_revised.py --rig dregon; Michael C3 is preserved and not retrained.
C4 uses the same generative family, ALL k=1..130 active from the first objective, no harmonic ladder.
Fixed OU empirical prior copied from C3 DREGON training: lambda=6 s^-1, sigma=3.10117415072719 rad/s; fixed, not re-estimated and not a causal identification claim.

Warm start path results/revised_phase/c3/dregon.json is the C3 DREGON training export (sha256 5d232ed9760b000a39583c54c8f9d9ee5e5baccfbedec2d63c5f6d5615956831) on the remote worktree; training parameters, bias and MAP states are loaded where clip IDs match.
D is reset after warm start to 2*pi*13.07 rad^2/s = 82.12123284912244 as initialization only; the first reported C4 joint objective is after that reset.
One conditional joint objective: full training L_cond/T + one OU state prior + existing parameter/bias priors; conditional kernel is exp(-D|tau|) because theta is in the atom.
Block order per cycle: carrier first (bias_hz, bias_mean_hz, theta/nu; spectral fixed), then spectral (P/floor/D/speed-law/mic; carrier/bias fixed).

Three cycles, 20 Adam proposal steps per block, lr=0.05, frames_per_step=1 per clip; proposal acceptance requires FULL fixed-training J decrease; up to four half-steps along the parameter segment, restore on failure.
No D narrowing, no annealing, no held-out trajectory or held-out audio in the fit.
